rules.description: silver.orders: Bronze에서 다시 계산한 결과와 다른 행 수 (재계산에만 있는 행 + 실제에만 있는 행)
rules.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT channel, event_id, order_id, user_id, shipping_fee, order_created_at FROM recon_orders EXCEPT SELECT channel, event_id, order_id, user_id, shipping_fee, order_created_at FROM {silver}.orders) a) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT channel, event_id, order_id, user_id, shipping_fee, order_created_at FROM {silver}.orders EXCEPT SELECT channel, event_id, order_id, user_id, shipping_fee, order_created_at FROM recon_orders) b) AS violations

rules.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT eh_partition, eh_offset FROM recon_rejected EXCEPT SELECT eh_partition, eh_offset FROM {silver}.quarantine) a) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT eh_partition, eh_offset FROM {silver}.quarantine EXCEPT SELECT eh_partition, eh_offset FROM recon_rejected) b) AS violations
